name: Homemade Jelly
tagline: Prickly pear, spicy prickly pear, and mesquite bean.
description: Small-batch jelly made from ruby-red Texas prickly pears and mesquite beans, each hand-picked at the perfect moment of ripeness and never mechanically harvested.
availability: Seasonal: made in small batches from each harvest.

name: Cinnamon Rolls
tagline: Soft, glazed cinnamon rolls in two Texas flavors.
description: Soft, glazed cinnamon rolls made by hand in two flavors from the Texas harvest: prickly pear and mesquite bean.
availability: Available only at Goliad Market Days, the 2nd Saturday of every month.
